reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per competitor check of a TV & Video product
  SELECT cp.product_id, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video'
),
latest AS (  -- one row per TV & Video product with a check
  SELECT product_id, CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) AS check_day, price_eur
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT l.product_id, l.price_eur AS competitor_price, ph.list_price_eur, l.price_eur - ph.list_price_eur AS gap_eur
FROM latest l
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = l.product_id
 AND ph.valid_from <= l.check_day AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR ph.valid_to >= l.check_day)

SELECT t.product_id, t.price_eur AS competitor_price, ph.list_price_eur, t.price_eur - ph.list_price_eur AS gap_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per competitor check of a TV & Video product, numbered from the latest
  SELECT cp.product_id, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video'
) AS t
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = t.product_id
 AND ph.valid_from <= CAST(t.observed_ts AS DATE) AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR ph.valid_to >= CAST(t.observed_ts AS DATE))
WHERE t.rn = 1

solver.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT cp.product_id, cp.price_eur, CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.product_id ORDER BY cp.observed_ts DESC, cp.competitor) AS rn FROM competitor_prices cp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video')
SELECT r.product_id, r.price_eur AS competitor_price, ph.list_price_eur, r.price_eur - ph.list_price_eur AS gap_eur
FROM r JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = r.product_id AND ph.valid_from <= r.d AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR ph.valid_to >= r.d)
WHERE r.rn = 1
